name: Metadata Notifier
overview: Sends on-screen toast notifications with HDR metadata, audio codec, and transcoding info
description: Metadata Notifier sends on-screen toast notifications when playback starts on any client. Displays HDR metadata systems (HDR10+, Dolby Vision, HDR10, HLG, and SDR), audio codecs (TrueHD Atmos, DTS-HD MA), and transcoding status. Fully configurable per client type.

versions.changelog: Restore the Settings button on the plugin card
Fix configuration page routing in Jellyfin dashboard (remove space in page name)
Add main menu sidebar integration under Extensions and fix technical audio names for Atmos/DTS:X
Rename plugin to Metadata Notifier. Add SDR support, customizable notification duration, and optimized configuration UI.
Initial release: Send on-screen toast notifications with HDR metadata, audio codecs, and transcoding status for Samsung TVs.

name: WatchSync
overview: Sync watch history between libraries of different qualities (4K/HD)
description: Automatically synchronizes watch history between libraries of different qualities (4K/HD). When a movie is watched in 4K, the HD version is also marked as watched (and vice versa). Uses IMDB, TMDB and TVDB identifiers to match media between libraries.

versions.changelog: Initial release with automatic sync and scheduled task

name: JellyTag
overview: Overlays quality badges (resolution, HDR, codec, audio, language) on media posters and thumbnails
description: JellyTag automatically overlays quality badges on your media posters and thumbnails. Supports resolution, HDR, video codec, audio, language flags, and VOST indicator. Badges are rendered server-side and visible on all Jellyfin clients. Features per-panel configuration, SVG and text badge styles, custom badge upload, live preview, and library filtering.
